project_type: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Zod 4, React Hook Form 7, Sonner toasts, no test framework
build_system: Next.js (npm scripts). No monorepo. `next build` does a full compile + type-check. Tailwind 4 via PostCSS — all design tokens are CSS custom properties in src/app/globals.css.
test_framework: None — the project has zero test files. Verification means `npm run build` and `npm run lint` both pass with exit code 0.
verification_instructions: 1. cd /Users/raheelarfeen/Programming-Hero_lvl_2/Assignment_6+7/RaktoSheba-Frontend  2. npm run build  3. npm run lint  Both must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors or ESLint warnings.
environment_constraints: recharts is NOT installed — install it with `npm install recharts@^2.15.0` before writing any chart code. Do not push to remote. Commit locally after each FEAT with specific file paths, then `git commit -m 'feat: ...'`.
contribution_requirements: Follow the existing code style exactly. Match token/class names seen in existing components (bg-cream, rounded-[24px], border-ink/10, font-display, etc.). No new utility libraries beyond recharts.
key_patterns: 1. Server Components are `async function Page()`, call `(await getSession())!`, fetch data inline. 2. Client components start with `'use client'`, use `useTransition` + `startTransition` for Server Actions. 3. Server Actions live in `src/app/actions/*.ts` with `'use server'` at top, call `getSession()`, role-check with `redirect()`, call `api(...)`, call `revalidatePath(...)`, return `{ ok: true } | { error: string }`. ActionResult type is `{ error: string } | { ok: true }`. 4. Admin token pattern mirrors hospitalToken(): `const session = await getSession(); if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') redirect('/auth/login?next=/dashboard/admin'); return session.accessToken;`. 5. Loading files: always `loading.tsx`, export default `Loading()`, use skeleton components. 6. Toast: `toast.error(result.error)` on action failure, `toast.success('...')` on success. 7. Confirm dialogs: use `src/components/ui/confirm-dialog.tsx` — mount only while open, pass `onConfirm`/`onClose`/`pending`/`tone`. 8. API layer: `src/lib/api.ts` exports `api<T>(path, options)` and `apiPaginated<T>(path, options)`. Authenticated calls pass `{ token, cache: 'no-store' }`. 9. Pagination: use `apiPaginated<T[]>` → `{ data, meta }` with `meta.totalPage`. 10. Nav: add admin pages to ADMIN array in `src/components/dashboard/nav-config.ts`. 11. Recharts: use `ResponsiveContainer` wrapping `AreaChart`/`BarChart`. Must be in a `'use client'` component. Import from 'recharts'. 12. Blood group badge tone (from request-card.tsx groupTone): critical/severe → `bg-blush text-blood`; urgent → `bg-sand text-sand-deep`; standard → `bg-mint text-forest`. 13. EmergencyBadge uses levelStyles: critical → `bg-blood text-cream`; severe → `bg-blush text-blood`; urgent → `bg-sand text-sand-deep`; standard → `bg-linen text-ink-muted`. 14. PageProps: use explicit `{ searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> }` for new routes (Next.js regenerates routes.d.ts on build).
directory_structure: src/app/dashboard/admin/ — currently has page.tsx (stat cards + requests by status) and loading.tsx. src/app/actions/ — server actions (donor.ts, auth.ts, hospital.ts, payments.ts). src/lib/ — API helpers and utilities (admin.ts currently only exports `adminApi.analytics`). src/types/index.ts — all backend types (Analytics, TimeSeries, AuditLog, Payment, Hospital, UserProfile all exist). src/components/dashboard/ — nav-config.ts (ADMIN array currently has only 1 item). src/components/ui/ — shared UI primitives including confirm-dialog.tsx.
